title: PEBR canonical state (UF) presidential poll
description: Stable identity for one UF-scoped presidential fieldwork+scenario. Parallel to poll.schema.json but geography=state with required uf. Shares are fractions in [0,1]. NEVER enters national Option B aggregates (canonical-points.json / canonical-points-2nd-round.json / chart.json). Assemble writes site/data/canonical-points-regional.json only.

poll_id.description: Stable canonical id after witness merge. Prefer including uf in the stem.

fieldwork_end.description: Required for trend ordering; primary fieldwork date.

geography.description: State-presidential scope. National poll.schema.json stays locked to geography=national — do not widen that enum.

uf.description: IBGE UF code for the state (or DF) where the presidential poll was fielded.

scenario.description: Same scenario keys as national (stimulated_1st_round / stimulated_2nd_round_<a>_vs_<b>). Never mix scenarios in one aggregate. Never mix UFs into a blended Brazil mean.

moe.description: Margin of error as fraction (e.g. 0.02 for ±2pp). Null if not published.

results.description: Map candidate_id → share as fraction in [0,1].

tse_registration_id.description: Optional TSE protocol (often UF-#####/YYYY for state packages; BR- may appear on national registrations with UF breakouts — treat as provenance only).

witness_ids.description: Coverage/publication witnesses merged into this poll.
